practicals.title: 1.​ Write a program to demonstrate basic input and
content: 1.​ Write a program to demonstrate basic input and
output operations in Python.
2.​ Write a program to illustrate the use of different
data types and type casting.
3.​ Write a program to perform arithmetic relational
and logical operations using Python operators.
4.​ Write a program to demonstrate string
operations including slicing formatting and
built-in string functions.
5.​ Write a program to create and manipulate lists
using indexing slicing and list comprehensions.
6.​ Write a program to illustrate the use of tuples
and sets with basic operations.
7.​ Write a program to create a dictionary and
demonstrate dictionary methods and iteration.
8.​ Write a program to explain mutable and
immutable objects in Python.
9.​ Write a program to define and use user-defined
functions with different types of arguments.
10.​Write a program to demonstrate recursion using
factorial or Fibonacci series.

practicals.title: 1.​ Write a program to demonstrate conditional
content: 1.​ Write a program to demonstrate conditional
statements using if if-else and if-elif-else.
2.​ Write a program to check whether a number is
positive negative or zero using nested
conditions.
3.​ Write a program to generate a multiplication
table using a for loop.
4.​ Write a program to find the sum of digits of a
number using a while loop.
5.​ Write a program to demonstrate the use of
break continue and pass statements.
6.​ Write a program to iterate over lists strings and
dictionaries using loops.
7.​ Write a program to demonstrate list dictionary
and set comprehensions.
8.​ Write a program to illustrate variable scope
using local global and nonlocal variables.
9.​ Write a program to demonstrate iterators and
iterables in Python.

10.​Write a program to generate a sequence of
numbers using generator functions and yield
keyword.

practicals.title: 1.​ Write a program to create and import a
content: 1.​ Write a program to create and import a
user-defined module.
2.​ Write a program to demonstrate different
import mechanisms in Python.
3.​ Write a program to perform mathematical
operations using math module.
4.​ Write a program to generate random numbers
using random module.
5.​ Write a program to display current date and
time using datetime module.
6.​ Write a program to perform file and directory
operations using os and sys modules.
7.​ Write a program to copy move and delete files
using shutil module.
8.​ Write a program to demonstrate basic regular
expression pattern matching.
9.​ Write a program to use re module functions
such as match search and findall.
10.​Write a program to extract specific information
from a text file using regular expressions.

practicals.title: 1.​ Write a program to create a class and object in
content: 1.​ Write a program to create a class and object in
Python.
2.​ Write a program to demonstrate constructor
and destructor usage.
3.​ Write a program to illustrate instance variables
and class variables.
4.​ Write a program to demonstrate instance
methods class methods and static methods.
5.​ Write a program to implement single multilevel
and multiple inheritance.
6.​ Write a program to demonstrate method
overriding and polymorphism.
7.​ Write a program to illustrate method resolution
order and magic methods.
8.​ Write a program to demonstrate encapsulation
and abstraction using classes.
9.​ Write a program to read and write data into a
file using different file modes.
10.​Write a program to perform file pointer
operations using seek and tell methods.

practicals.title: 1.​ Write a program to demonstrate different types
content: 1.​ Write a program to demonstrate different types
of errors and exceptions in Python.
2.​ Write a program to handle exceptions using try
except else and finally blocks.
3.​ Write a program to define and raise
user-defined exceptions.
4.​ Write a program to demonstrate the use of
assert statement.
5.​ Write a program to perform basic data analysis
using Pandas DataFrame.
6.​ Write a program to create a DataFrame from
CSV or Excel files.
7.​ Write a program to handle missing data using
dropna and fillna methods.
8.​ Write a program to plot line bar histogram and
pie charts using Python.
9.​ Write a program to connect Python with a
database and execute SQL queries.
10.​Write a program to retrieve database records
using fetchone fetchmany and fetchall methods.
